reason: Moves the Delete action from a form POST on the Edit page to a separate GET-routed link on the list page while keeping the same authorization and confirmation UX, so behavior is largely equivalent but changes to the AdminController action signature/attributes (removing ActionName/FormValueRequired) could affect any other code or extensions relying on the old routing convention.
